card: This PR checks the most recent hardcoded AssumeUTXO commitment during normal Initial Block Download once block connection reaches that height, requesting node shutdown on a mismatch. Full nodes independently reconstruct the UTXO set from genesis, but previously never verified whether their reconstructed UTXO set matched the baked-in snapshot commitments. To limit the performance overhead of full UTXO hashing during IBD, older AssumeUTXO commitments are removed in favor of only the latest commitment per network.
evidence: PR description citing #32377: "Every node reconstructs the same UTXO set during ordinary IBD, but does not check its hash against the existing AssumeUTXO commitment."
Commit 36a2a70452: "This checks the developer-provided commitment against the UTXO set that every node reconstructs during IBD (see #32377)."
problem: AssumeUTXO relies on hardcoded snapshot hashes baked into the binary. Although full nodes reconstruct the entire UTXO set during normal IBD, they never verify their reconstructed UTXO set against the hardcoded commitment, missing an opportunity for independent crowd-sourced verification of the hardcoded hashes against chain history.

risk.why: A bug in UTXO hashing, disk flushing, or error handling during block connection could halt IBD or trigger unintended node shutdowns on valid chains.

scope_notes: Modifies chainparams to drop support for older AssumeUTXO snapshots, allowing only the latest commitment per network to be used or verified.
summary: Validates the hardcoded AssumeUTXO commitment during normal Initial Block Download when block connection reaches the commitment height. Pending UTXO changes are flushed to disk, the UTXO set is hashed, and the node requests shutdown if the hash does not match the commitment. To avoid repeated expensive UTXO hashing during IBD, chainparams is changed to retain only the single most recent AssumeUTXO commitment per network.
